pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Breeding? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Breeding.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Breeding.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Breeding.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Erosion Control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Erosion Control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Erosion Control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Erosion Control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Erosion Control.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Cropping? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Cropping.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Cropping.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Cropping.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Cropping.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Nutrition.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Nutrition.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Nutrition.

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forage Crops? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Forage Crops.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forage Crops.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forage Crops.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forage Crops.

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Breeding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Disease Control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

2. D — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.

4. A — newton (N)

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Erosion Control.

6. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Cropping.

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.

8. C — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forage Crops.

10. C — Producers

11. D — 100 °C

12. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Livestock Nutrition; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Animal Breeding; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Animal Health: Disease Control; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
